integrity: Algebraic proof gives a polynomial identity, classical Jacobi zero theorem, and triangular-array central limit theorem; reproducible exact checks are finite corroboration only.
scientific_limitations: Only numbers with exactly two distinct prime factors; real-root classification does not extend by this proof to arbitrary prime support; no local limit theorem or independent mathematical audit is claimed. The length-count coefficients and divisor-function polynomials themselves precede this analysis.
title: Jacobi zeros and Gaussian lengths for two-prime ordered factorizations
